_comentario: MODELO TEENS. VOZES: 'ellen' esta REMAPEADA para uma voz de adolescente (a mesma tecnica que o modelo kids usa por padrao) porque a aluna tem 12 anos e ellen/arthur do voices.json global sao vozes ADULTAS. Assim a voz da Sophia (falas em 1a pessoa + alternancia de narracao) e de adolescente, e a colega do dialogo (Ruby) tem uma SEGUNDA voz de adolescente, distinta. 'arthur' fica intocado e cobre palavras soltas e o host adulto do listening 2.

listenings.text: Hi everyone, I am Ruby and this is my first message here, so sorry if it is a bit long. I live in Manchester, in the north of England, and I am twelve. I am really into drawing, mostly people, and I play the drums, badly. At the moment I am learning Spanish at school and it is going terribly, so if anyone speaks Spanish, please help me. Most of the time I hang out with my cousin because she lives on the same street. And actually, I am an only child, like a lot of people in this club, apparently. That is it. How about you?

Welcome to the club, everybody. Here is how this works. We meet every Wednesday at five, always for one hour, and we always start the same way: everyone says three things about themselves and asks one question back. That is the rule. It sounds small, but it is the whole thing. This month we are trying something new. We are pairing every new member with somebody from a different country, so this week you are not talking to the whole group, you are talking to one person. Look at the message with your name on it. Your partner is already waiting for you.

items.situation: Somebody new asks what you do in your spare time. Answer with two things, and say which one you do more.
Somebody asks what you are studying at the moment. Answer, and say how it is going.
You and the other person like the same thing. Say it, and ask one question about it.
Somebody asks about your family. Answer in two sentences, and add one surprising fact.
You have said three things about yourself. Now give the turn back, twice, in two different ways.
